definitionZh: 视图- 过渡名称 CSS 属性指定选定元素将参与的视图过渡快照 。 这使得您可以将这些元素与页面的其余部分分开激活,这些部分在视图过渡时使用默认的交叉虚构动画. 然后可以定义这些元素的自定义动画风格.
sourceDefinition: The view-transition-name CSS property specifies the view transition snapshot that selected elements will participate in. This enables you to animate those elements separately from the rest of the page, which uses the default cross-fade animation during a view transition. You can then define custom animation styles for these elements.
